newsitem.title: FINLAND: ICE HOCKEY-SWEDEN TAKES ONE GAME LEAD.
newsitem.headline: ICE HOCKEY-SWEDEN TAKES ONE GAME LEAD.

text.p: Sweden took a one- game lead in the best-of-three final of the ice hockey world championship by beating Canada 3-2 on Sunday.
Marcus Thuresson scored what proved to be the winning goal with just under four minutes to play.
Canadian netminder Sean Burke stopped Magnus Svensson on a breakaway but could not control the rebound as Thuresson lifted the loose puck over the sprawling goaltender to put Sweden ahead 3-1.
With Burke pulled in favour of an extra attacker, Anson Carter deflected Keith Primeau's pass past Tommy Salo to cut the deficit to 3-2 with 38 seconds left.
But the Canadians could not get the equaliser.
